cards.title: Define original sleep and motivation content strategy
acceptance: Eight-hour format and publishing cadence are explicit
All audio, visuals, scripts and voice inputs have provenance gates
YouTube monetization risks and mitigations are documented

cards.title: Audit existing YouTube and Clippers architecture
acceptance: Account and OAuth blockers are explicit
Required tests and ownership boundaries are proposed

cards.title: Build deterministic eight-hour sleep-video pipeline
acceptance: Default output duration is at least eight hours
Audio and visuals are generated locally without external samples
Rights manifest, ffprobe QA and CI-friendly short mode exist
cards.mergeGate: Focused tests, technical QA and independent review pass

cards.title: Build original Spanish motivation Shorts pipeline
acceptance: Vertical 9:16 output is 20 to 40 seconds with readable captions
Voice, rights, dedupe and QA gates fail closed
cards.mergeGate: Focused tests, editorial QA and independent review pass

cards.title: Independent review and App QA release gate
acceptance: Eight-hour pilot passes start, middle and end inspection
No publishing occurs without verified channel evidence
cards.mergeGate: PR exists, focused tests pass, reviewer findings are resolved, and YouTube publishing remains blocked until a verified authorized channel is connected

cards.title: Connect verified YouTube channel before external publishing
acceptance: YouTube channel is verified for uploads longer than 15 minutes
Channel identity and publishing authorization are recorded in the Clippers workspace
Upload destination, title, description, thumbnail and audience settings are approved
cards.mergeGate: External upload/publish may start only after this card leaves blocked
